scope: offline visual candidate review; no Steam client verification
method: Viewed every assets/*.png actual file (10 assets).
Viewed both proof boards, native records/small-120x45.png (120x45) and updated records/small-proof-crop.png at its native 900x500 dimensions.
Viewed emblem-alpha-check.png on light and dark backgrounds; inspected alpha pixel values without modifying art.
Re-viewed final correction5 library asset and both rebuilt proof boards; library artwork visibly matches rebuilt proof instances.
Final tiny recheck: dark temporary title on rebuilt proof02 and regenerated standalone native 120x45 inspected; no additional asset edits.

generated_text.note: No letters/wordmarks visibly baked into candidate art; proof typography is explicit temporary overlay. Heraldic tower and cloak decoration are symbols, not text.

historical_house_restrictions.note: Final correction5 library capsule re-viewed at native 600x900: isolated church tower emerges above grove; house roofs show no definite chimney or prohibited door mark. No definite prohibited house chimney/door mark found elsewhere. Roof ridge highlights and gable projections were not counted as chimneys.

style.note: Warm ochre light, muted foliage, blue-grey distance, burgundy lord and painted timber/plaster town are coherent across capsule and panorama family; parchment background and emblem are coordinated companion treatments.

aspect_composition.note: Main establishes town/market; header and small shift subjects left with quiet right title field; vertical makes lord dominant; library adds banner; hero uses wide river/bridge. Compositions visibly adapt subject balance to aspect.

logo_quiet_zones.note: Temporary English/Korean titles fit without hiding primary silhouettes. Upper sky in main/vertical/library and right haze in header/small provide clear separation.

small_native_120x45.note: Town cluster and tower recognizable at actual 120x45; lord is a tiny distinguishable burgundy standing silhouette on left, not detailed person identity. Updated bold three-line English proof improves FEUDAL/LORD readability; SIMULATOR is still very small. No text/subject overlap.

hero_lower_center_ui.note: Specified middle-third x / lower-third y rectangle overlays water, shrubs and field. Key lord, tower, town and bridge remain outside this rectangle. Other Steam layouts/crops were not tested.

emblem_alpha.note: Transparent emblem and icons appear clean against supplied light/dark backgrounds; no visible bad halo. Raw viewer exposes red RGB residue on very low alpha pixels; this does not resemble the composited result.

nonblocking_findings.action: Preserve current left silhouette; do not claim facial/person detail survives 120x45.
Optional alpha cleanup can remove alpha<=5 residue, but current light/dark composites show no visible fringe.

limits: No live Steam client, upload, DPI or platform crop verification.
Visual inspection cannot prove exhaustive absence of every tiny historical detail.
This is candidate art visual QA, not game runtime integration.

resolved_findings.resolution: Re-viewed rebuilt proof02: dark brown temporary title is clearly readable against sky; previous contrast observation resolved.

Root regenerated 120x45 from final exported asset using Sharp. Re-viewed native standalone; tower/town/lord silhouette judgment unchanged. Earlier comparison against Pillow Lanczos is not applicable to Sharp resampling.
